classification_policy.contextual_rule: A token alone is not proof. system_domain_vocabulary requires a contextual identifier/literal that names a business concept or behavior; import classifications require an exact resolved dependency.
classification_policy.clean_generic: Target contains corpus-generic meta-type data/evaluation and no contextual system corpus or forbidden internal dependency in the reviewed full file. This does not settle whether inline evaluation duplicates family-owned semantics.
classification_policy.system_domain_vocabulary: Target embeds Financial Settlement business names, identifiers, state, routes, or outcomes.
classification_policy.fixture_corpus_import: Target directly imports a system/example fixture or candidate fixture.
classification_policy.semantic_evaluator_decoder_import: Target directly imports runtime family evaluation or decoding behavior that the selected Design assigns to composition.
classification_policy.realization_import: Target directly imports a realization-owned module.
classification_policy.inline_domain_case_construction: Target declares or constructs a Financial Settlement case/entity/value within the generic target layer.
classification_policy.test_only_evidence: Target directly imports hostile/mutation evidence intended for validation rather than reusable target runtime.
classification_policy.uncertain: Either a target language slot has no source declaration, or a corpus-generic target implements evaluator behavior inline whose semantic owner cannot be settled by dependency/corpus evidence alone.

firewall_analysis.current_scope: TypeScript runtime import path firewall; type-only imports are intentionally excluded.
false_negatives: Policy TypeScript/Python/Rust hard-code settlement.route.* strategy identities without any forbidden import.
Entity, Value Object, Operation, Query, and Calculation targets embed Financial Settlement concepts in all three languages without cross-layer imports.
Rule Python imports fixtures.can_settle_payout and Rule Rust includes ../../fixtures/can_settle_payout.rs; the current TypeScript-only import scanner does not inspect either language.
State Machine and Workflow Python/Rust embed settlement states, effect intents, or outcomes without a forbidden TypeScript import.
false_positive_risk: A path segment named fixtures does not by itself prove system leakage; ownership and fixture contents must be checked.
Family contract type-only imports are benign shape dependencies under the current contract and must not be promoted to runtime violations.
Generic words such as state, route, account, or order are not sufficient evidence without contextual business identifiers or behavior.
